item.g:title: Woolrich "Cleveland" Down Parka Jacket Black
item.g:description: Built for serious weather protection, the Woolrich Men "Cleveland" Parka delivers heritage craftsmanship with modern performance. This extended-length jacket combines a water-repellent outer shell with strategic layering to shield you from wind and moisture across seasons. The dual-closure system—zipper and button—provides redundant security, while generously proportioned pockets keep essentials accessible. Engineered from premium materials that resist the elements without compromising breathability, the Cleveland maintains its structure and appearance through repeated wear. Technical specifications Color: Black Gender: Men Shell: 67% Cotton, 33% Polyamide Lining: 100% Polyamide Insulation: 70% Duck Down, 30% Feathers Made in: Moldavia Manufacturer Woolrich Woolrich Europe S.p.A. 08005890834 Via della Cooperazione 21 40129 Bologna Italy customer.care@woolrich.com

item.g:title: Jimmy Choo Platform Sandals
item.g:description: Discover the epitome of sophisticated style with the Jimmy Choo Sandals, a masterpiece of elegance that effortlessly blends luxury with comfort. These sandals are a testament to the iconic design philosophy of Jimmy Choo, featuring a refined black satin exterior that exudes a timeless charm. The Gian sandal's signature aesthetic is brought to life through the use of premium materials and a meticulous construction process, ensuring a perfect balance between fashion and functionality. The model boasts a sleek, high-heeled design with a 14 cm heel height, offering a statuesque silhouette that complements any outfit. The square toe and buckle closure add a touch of modern flair, while the 4 cm external plateau and leather shoe sole provide the necessary support for all-day wear. Crafted from the finest leather, these sandals are not just a statement piece but also a durable investment for your wardrobe.

item.g:title: Dolce & Gabbana Grey Stretch Formal Trousers
item.g:description: Dive into the epitome of Italian sartorial excellence with Dolce & Gabbana's Grey Stretch Formal Trousers, a masterpiece that embodies the essence of Milanese craftsmanship. These trousers are not merely a piece of clothing; they're a statement of sophistication, designed to elevate your wardrobe with their timeless elegance. Crafted with a meticulous eye for detail, these slim-fit trousers are made from a luxurious blend of 97% wool and 3% elastane, ensuring a responsive comfort that complements your movements without compromising on style. The grey wool composition is not just a color choice; it's a nod to the versatility and understated chic that Dolce & Gabbana is renowned for. The trousers boast a structured fit that flatters the figure, with a waist measurement of 50 cm and a front rise of 24 cm, offering a tailored silhouette that's both flattering and fashion-forward. The 100 cm inseam ensures a perfect length that's ideal for various occasions. What sets these trousers apart is the signature logo detailing, a hallmark of Dolce & Gabbana's luxury pedigree. This logo, along with the trousers' unworn condition and original packaging, underscores their collectible status, making them an investment piece for the discerning fashionista. Model: Dress Pants trousers Color: Gray Fitting: Slim fit Material: 97% Wool, 3% Elastane Button and zip fly closure Measurements: Waist: 50 cm Front rise: 24 cm Inseam: 100 cm Made in Italy, these Grey Stretch Formal Trousers are a testament to Dolce & Gabbana's commitment to quality and elegance. With three available images to showcase their impeccable design, these trousers are a must-have for anyone looking to add a touch of Italian luxury to their wardrobe.

item.g:title: Baldinini Trend Men Wool Blue Suit
item.g:description: Tailored for the discerning gentleman, this Baldinini Trend wool suit combines refined craftsmanship with contemporary elegance. Constructed from 100% pure wool in a sophisticated blue tone, it features a streamlined slim fit that flatters the modern silhouette. The jacket showcases button fastening and long sleeves, while the signature Baldinini logo adds a touch of prestige. The solid color palette ensures versatility for both boardroom and evening occasions, making it an essential investment piece for any luxury wardrobe. Gender: Man Type: Men suit Fastening: buttons Sleeves: long Material: wool 100% Pattern: solid colour Fit: slim Details: visible logo

item.g:title: PARAJUMPERS Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket
item.g:description: Dive into the world of outdoor fashion with the Parajumpers Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket, a true testament to the timeless appeal of the Sheen family's iconic design. This versatile, down-filled jacket, crafted from a luxurious blend of 60% polyester and 40% polyamide, is more than just a piece of outerwear—it's a statement of style and functionality. The Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket boasts a 100% duck down filling, ensuring warmth and comfort in the chilliest of climates. Its shiny finish not only adds a touch of elegance but also showcases the high-quality craftsmanship that Parajumpers is known for. The jacket's simple yet sophisticated design makes it a wardrobe essential for those who appreciate the beauty of minimalism. Featuring an adjustable drawstring hood, the Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket offers versatile protection against the elements. The front closure is conveniently secured with a two-way zip, allowing for easy on and off. With two outer zippered pockets and two inner pockets, you'll have ample space to keep your essentials close at hand. The jacket's thoughtful design includes ribbed cuffs and a bottom, ensuring a snug fit that keeps the cold out while maintaining a sleek silhouette. The iconic Parajumpers patch on the sleeve and the vibrant yellow tape closure at the neck add a touch of personality, making this jacket a true conversation starter. Available in the XL size, the Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket is the perfect addition to your outdoor wardrobe. With four available images showcasing its impeccable design, you're sure to find the perfect jacket to elevate your style and keep you warm and comfortable on your next adventure. SHELL: 60% POLYESTER 40% POLYAMIDE LINING 1: 100% POLYAMIDE FILL: 100% DUCK DOWN

item.g:description: Ultra-light women's jacket from the Spring Summer 2020 collection. A must-have for those who want to have a unique and modern piece in the wardrobe, offering the possibility to show off an iconic and original look. Refined and cool appearance, made in laminated nylon with a metallic and slightly satin appearance. Partially lined, breathable and extremely comfortable. Our Diann Jacket is a highly researched garment with a unique and original look. Extremely functional and versatile, refined in every detail and with high performances in terms of breathability and comfort. Composed externally in ultra-light laminated nylon with a metallic and satin appearance. This women's summer jacket is equipped with many comforts: adjustable rain hood with two elastic bands, two practical pockets on the front to store your items, elastic cuffs for maximum protection in case of wind or rain and an unmistakable style that will upgrade your outift. Comfortable and feminine fit, ultra-light and breathable fabric, pleasant to wear during the spring summer period for a walk with friends or for a trip out of town during the weekend.

item.g:title: MM6 Maison Margiela Anatomic Ankle Boot Black
item.g:description: The MM6 Maison Margiela ankle boot redefines contemporary footwear through a rigorous architectural approach. Crafted with a soft nappa leather finish in a deep black shade, the silhouette features the brand’s iconic rounded “Anatomic” toe. A cylindrical block heel provides a structural contrast to the fluid lines of the upper, while an internal side zipper ensures a precise, snug fit around the ankle. The design is completed by the distinctive “White Stitch Line” on the back collar, a subtle yet unmistakable marker of the brand’s identity. A definitive accessory that defines the modern wardrobe with uncompromising sculptural precision. - 'Anatomic' toe - Cylindrical block heel - Side zipper closure - 'White Stitch Line' on the back - Leather lining Colour: Black Composition: 100% Polyester Made in Italy Style code: S59WU0235P3628T8013

item.g:title: Brunello Cucinelli Active Sneakers Black
item.g:description: Brunello Cucinelli's 'Active' sneakers blend a sporty aesthetic with the brand's artisan excellence. The upper features a sophisticated play of textures, combining soft suede inserts with smooth techno fabric panels. The interior is enriched by a warm shearling lining, visible on the collar, which ensures superior thermal comfort. The front lacing is embellished with the iconic 'Monile' detail, the maison's luminous signature, while the structured tank sole offers grip and a contemporary volume. An essential shoe that elevates the winter wardrobe through a perfect balance between functionality and material luxury. - Upper in suede and techno fabric - Shearling lining - 'Monile' detail on the fastening - Flat laces in cotton - TPU tank rubber sole - Embossed logo on the heel Colour: Black Composition: 100% Calfskin leather (Bos Taurus) Made in Italy Style code: MZSFG3384C9795
